method: search_news 24h max_results=10; get_posts_counts_recent 24h (day granularity, from 2026-10-10T01:07Z; total_tweet_count)

filter_note.note: Saturday of Week 5, eve of Sunday. Loudest rooms ARI (Marvin Harrison Jr. told to sit vs. DET while a trade is finalized, destination undisclosed, HOU reported top suitor), CHI (Khalil Mack reunion chatter, Bagent likely starts at GB), DAL (Dak confronts worker, Schottenheimer/Tomlin talk), NE, NO, HOU, PHI, BUF, CLE. Status-heavy: Lamar out SNF (Huntley starts), Eagles without Barkley/Smith/Brown in London, Bills without Oliver/Palmer with Moore questionable for MNF, Aaron Donald returning for LAR, Jeanty questionable, Patriots without Gonzalez/Davis, Slater IR and Alt out for LAC, Pittman IR, Bosa out, Hall out, Slayton out, Chase/Higgins questionable, Jefferson/Addison questionable, Daniels starts for WSH. CAR, HOU and TEN fully quiet (HOU volume likely lifted by the Harrison trade talk, which surfaced only in ARI's pull). Volume method changed tonight to full 24h total_tweet_count, so numbers are not comparable to prior nights' partial-bucket figures. Dropped mostly college football (Red River, UGA-Bama, Vols/Arkansas), NBA Knicks, MLB playoffs, F1/NASCAR/NHL, fantasy/parlay contests, Pokemon roster game, nachos cam, accent trolling, Lions silver pants, Patriots 2001 nostalgia, Minneapolis Miracle replay, and cross-club near-dupes.

items.title: Cardinals finalizing Marvin Harrison Jr. trade, destination undisclosed
